name: Exec Cluster Cost: Volume Impact — PerShare Commission + Almgren-Chriss
description: Tests: PerShare commission + VolumeImpact slippage (Almgren-Chriss market impact). Run with --cost volume_impact
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: Volume Impact (Market Impact Model)
# Run with: --cost volume_impact --cash 100000
# Validates: VolumeImpact slippage = coefficient * sqrt(order_qty / ADV)
# Stress-tests large-position cost modeling
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: SMA trend ===
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
is_above = close > sma_200
held = hold_until()(enter=is_above, exit=not is_above)

# === EXECUTION: Large position to exercise volume impact ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=40)

atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=7)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 3)
